shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc "pwd && rg --files -g 'package.json' -g 'AGENTS.md' -g 'src/**' -g 'app/**' | head -100 && printf '\\n--- package.json ---\\n' && cat package.json"
/bin/bash -lc "cat src/App.tsx && printf '\\n--- main ---\\n' && cat src/main.tsx && printf '\\n--- css ---\\n' && cat src/index.css && npm install @gravity-ui/uikit"

/bin/bash -lc "rg --files node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components | rg '/(Input|Button|Checkbox|theme)/' | head -60 && printf '\\n--- theme exports ---\\n' && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/theme/index.d.ts"

/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,220p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/controls/TextInput/TextInput.d.ts; printf '\\n--- button ---\\n'; sed -n '1,180p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Button/Button.d.ts; printf '\\n--- checkbox ---\\n'; sed -n '1,180p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Checkbox/Checkbox.d.ts; printf '\\n--- provider ---\\n'; sed -n '1,100p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/theme/Provider.d.ts; rg 'gravity' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/styles.css | head"

/bin/bash -lc "cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/package.json | node -e \"let d='';process.stdin.on('data',c=>d+=c).on('end',()=>{const p=JSON.parse(d); console.log(JSON.stringify(p.exports,null,2)); console.log(JSON.stringify(p.peerDependencies,null,2));})\" && rg --files node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build | rg 'css"'$'"' | head"

/bin/bash -lc 'npm run dev -- --host 127.0.0.1 --port 5173 >/tmp/vite.log 2>&1 & echo $! > /tmp/vite.pid; sleep 1; curl -fsS http://127.0.0.1:5173/ | head -20; kill $(cat /tmp/vite.pid); cat /tmp/vite.log'
/bin/bash -lc "rg '\"@gravity-ui/uikit\"' package.json && git diff -- src/App.tsx src/main.tsx src/index.css 2>/dev/null || true"
